_doc: Every feel/balance number in Wyrmroad. Read through the live tuning object at use time (shared/tune.js; ` key or ?tune), written back by tools/apply-tune.mjs wyrmroad. Distances in metres.

depthSpeed.label: Up/down speed
depthSpeed.note: Moving into and out of the screen

laneAlign.label: Lane align
laneAlign.note: How far an attack nudges you up or down to line up with the enemy you face

comboWindow.label: Combo window
comboWindow.note: Time after a hit to press Attack again for the next hit

inputBuffer.label: Input buffer
inputBuffer.note: A press this early still counts

getUpGrace.label: Get-up safety
getUpGrace.note: Can’t be hit just after standing up

blockCut.label: Block strength
blockCut.note: Share of a frontal hit that a block stops

perfectBlock.label: Perfect block window
perfectBlock.note: Blocking this soon before a hit staggers the attacker

throwDamage.label: Throw damage
throwDamage.note: Times your power, to the thrown enemy and anyone it hits

grabHold.label: Grab hold time
grabHold.note: How long you can hold an enemy before it breaks free

breakerCost.label: Breaker health cost
breakerCost.note: Share of max health the Breaker costs (never kills)

breakerRamp.label: Breaker repeat cost
breakerRamp.note: Extra share of max health for each Breaker used recently

breakerCool.label: Breaker cool-off
breakerCool.note: Seconds for one recent Breaker to stop adding to the cost

manaOnHit.label: Mana per hit
manaOnHit.note: Mana gained each time you land a hit

attackTokens.label: Enemies attacking at once
attackTokens.note: Per hero: the rest circle and wait their turn

foeWindup.label: Enemy wind-up
foeWindup.note: How long enemies show an attack before it lands

coopHealth.label: Co-op enemy health
coopHealth.note: Extra health per hero after the first (normal enemies)

coopBossHealth.label: Co-op boss health
coopBossHealth.note: Extra boss health per hero after the first

coopFoes.label: Co-op crowd size
coopFoes.note: Extra enemies in each wave per hero after the first, as a share of the wave

coopDamage.label: Co-op enemy damage
coopDamage.note: Extra enemy damage per hero after the first

maxFoes.label: Most enemies at once
maxFoes.note: Co-op extras stop at this many on screen

riseClear.label: Rise-up clearance
riseClear.note: Enemies climbing out of the ground never come up closer than this to a hero

pairEnrage.label: Pair boss fury
pairEnrage.note: Extra power for the one left standing when a pair of bosses loses one

downTime.label: Time to revive
downTime.note: A downed hero waits this long for a partner before losing a life

respawnGrace.label: Respawn safety
respawnGrace.note: Can’t be hit after coming back in

foodHeal.label: Food heal
foodHeal.note: Share of max health a meal heals

regenOutside.label: Regen between fights
regenOutside.note: Gear health regen works only between fights, this many times faster

viewWidth.label: View width
viewWidth.note: Width of road the screen shows

skyAlly.label: Wyrm in the sky
skyAlly.note: 1 = Ossmara breathes fire on your foes in chapters where she flies with you; 0 = off

skyDelay.label: Sky fire warning
skyDelay.note: Time the warning line shows before her fire lands
